text:
Alex Gomez: hey team - manager requesting a one-time relocation + sign-on package split across FYs for candidate Luis Ortega. total one-time = $9,000 (4.5k now, 4.5k in next FY). start target 2026-07-01. is this routed as an exception? what approvals and timeline?

People Ops: @Alex yes, that's an offer exception (split payment). we need: comp committee approval, finance sign-off for cross-FY coding, and payroll scheduling. please submit an Offer Exception request and attach the offer packet.

Maya Singh: to be explicit - include the comp band, base, any sign-on precedent for role, and whether relocation is taxable reimbursement or lump. that affects payroll setup.

Alex Gomez: band = L4 / Band 4, base $145,000. relocation is lump one-time taxable. manager requests split to accommodate current FY cap. no bonus offset.

CompOps Bot: Exception draft created: EXC-2026-089. Status: pending initial review. Linked ticket: Offer Exception form.

People Ops: Routing steps: 1) fill Offer Exception form (select "split one-time payment"); 2) attach candidate packet and manager justification; 3) tag @CompOps and @Finance; 4) People Ops triage, then comp committee review; 5) if approved, People Ops will create Payroll ticket with exact dates for payments.

Alex Gomez: timeline ask - can comp committee decide by 2026-06-20? hiring manager wants to issue offer by 2026-06-22.

Finance: FY note - we can approve split payments across FYs but need a committed date for the payment in the next FY to earmark budget. Finance needs approval at least 7 business days before the next fy payment to reserve coding.

Payroll: Operational note - Payroll requires 10 business days lead time before each payment. split payments processed as two taxable lumps; please include payroll codes and whether to mark as "one-time relocation" in benefit records.

Maya Singh: manager please add retention tie (e.g., 6-month retention check) to help comp committee approve.

Alex Gomez: manager adds: retention check at 6 months and hiring insistence that split is necessary due to current FY hiring freeze on one-time payouts. added to EXC-2026-089 notes.

People Ops: Comp committee scheduled next Tue morning. marking EXC-2026-089 expedited. i'll post result here. :pray:

CompOps Bot: Comp committee requested clarification on whether candidate is internal transfer (different tax implications). action: Alex to confirm.

Alex Gomez: confirmed external hire. updated EXC-2026-089.

People Ops: Approved by comp committee. EXC-2026-089 status: approved. Next steps: People Ops will create Payroll ticket with dates: initial payment at offer acceptance (expected 2026-06-24), deferred payment on 2027-01-10 (first payroll of FY27). Finance confirmed budget hold for 4.5k on 2027-01-10.

Payroll: Ticket created: PAY-2026-331. Please confirm exact preferred calendar date for deferred payment text to place in journal entry.

Alex Gomez: confirmed dates. will draft offer language referencing split payment schedule and retention check. thanks all.
